name: Emergency & Trauma Resuscitation
inclusionCriteria: Acute stroke symptoms within 4.5 hour window
prerequisites: Immediate zero-wait entry. No registration paperwork required before stabilization.

name: General Outpatient Medicine
inclusionCriteria: General health checkups and preliminary screenings
prerequisites: Valid triage token, previous prescription booklet, and recent vitals slip.

name: Cardiology & Vascular Medicine
inclusionCriteria: Chronic angina, ischemic heart disease follow-up
Hypertensive urgency without acute end-organ failure
prerequisites: Prior 12-lead ECG strip from Triage and previous echo reports if available.

name: Orthopedics & Joint Care
inclusionCriteria: Severe sprains, ligament tears, acute joint effusion
Chronic spine pain, osteoarthritis, sports injuries
prerequisites: Immobilize limb. Do not bear weight. Digital X-ray slip from triage.

name: Central Diagnostic Blood & Pathology Lab
inclusionCriteria: Blood sample collection (CBC, LFT, KFT, Lipid Profile, Blood Sugar)
Urine routine and microscopy sample submission
prerequisites: Fasting of 8-10 hours required for fasting blood sugar and lipid profile. Water is permitted.

name: Radiology, X-Ray & Ultrasound Center
location: Basement 1, Diagnostic Center, Rooms B-12 to B-18
prerequisites: For Abdominal Ultrasound: Full bladder (drink 3-4 glasses of water 45 min prior) and 6 hours fasting.

name: Outpatient Dispensary & Pharmacy
prerequisites: Original doctor signed prescription token or verified digital prescription ID.
